newsitem.title: USA: Two killed in Nashville dynamite blast.
newsitem.headline: Two killed in Nashville dynamite blast.

text.p: A big dynamite explosion near downtown Nashville killed at least two construction workers on Monday and shut down two interstate higways for miles.
Fourteeen people were taken to hospitals with injuries from the blast. Police spokesman Don Aaron said one construction worker was missing.
"A premature explosion at a construction site occurred on the bluff overlooking the juncture of interstate 40 with interstate 24 resulting in total traffic gridlock," Aaron said.
Two workers and 12 motorists were injured by debris and one motorist, truck driver David Langford, said that a body hit his truck. Aaron said the injuries were believed not to be life-threatening.
Nashville Metro traffic officer David Parks said: "We are still unclear as to the cause of the explosion."
The blast occurred during the morning rush-hour at a Tennessee State Highway Department project to widen exit ramps.
